# ============================================================
# DRAFT — INCOMPLETE. NOT READY FOR EXECUTION.
# All PLACEHOLDER_* values are unfilled and must be resolved
# before this workflow can run. See PLACEHOLDERS.md for the
# list of missing details.
# ============================================================

# Minimal placeholder structure for the order-to-cash automation.
# Fill in the TODO values, then promote each `PLACEHOLDER_*` to a real binding.

name: order-to-cash
version: 0.1.0-draft
description: Order-to-cash workflow (DRAFT - incomplete, awaiting details)
trigger:
  # TODO: order intake channel. Options: webhook | email | sftp-file | manual
  type: PLACEHOLDER_INTAKE_CHANNEL
  config: {}            # e.g. webhook: {path: /orders/new, method: POST}

inputs:
  orderId: string
  customerId: string
  items: "array<{sku: string, qty: number}>"

steps:
  validate-order:
    type: task          # manual review vs. service call - TODO
    handler: PLACEHOLDER_VALIDATION_SERVICE

  check-credit:
    type: task
    handler: PLACEHOLDER_CREDIT_CHECK_SYSTEM   # system of record - TODO
    on-fail: request-prepayment

  request-prepayment:
    type: task
    handler: PLACEHOLDER_PREPAYMENT_REQUEST
    # terminal branch -> outputs.status: rejected-credit

  check-inventory:
    type: task
    handler: PLACEHOLDER_INVENTORY_SYSTEM
    on-fail: backorder-policy

  backorder-policy:
    type: policy       # decision step, not a handler task
    # TODO: wait-and-retry | partial-shipment | cancel
    strategy: PLACEHOLDER_BACKORDER_POLICY
    retry: {}           # e.g. {interval: P1D, maxAttempts: 5}

  ship-order:
    type: task
    handler: PLACEHOLDER_SHIPPING_PROVIDER

  send-invoice:
    type: task
    handler: PLACEHOLDER_INVOICING_SYSTEM

  wait-for-payment:
    type: timer-wait
    # TODO: reminder cadence
    timeout: PLACEHOLDER_PAYMENT_TIMEOUT        # e.g. P14D
    reminder: PLACEHOLDER_REMINDER_CADENCE      # e.g. every P7D, max 3

  record-payment:
    type: task
    handler: PLACEHOLDER_PAYMENTS_LEDGER

outputs:
  status: completed | rejected-invalid | rejected-credit | backordered
